description: Hidden data was written into the reserved space located directly after the second vdev label in a ZFS device. This area, typically between 512 KiB and 4 MiB, remains unused by the ZFS filesystem and can therefore store arbitrary data without affecting pool integrity. The region was filled with repeated 'HIDDEN DATA' strings.
plaintext_preview: HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA ...
notes: The reserved region after label 1 is not referenced by the ZFS filesystem.
It can hold additional data until the pool is expanded or rewritten.
Detection requires scanning unallocated region after vdev label1 (2. label) .
